definitions.gloss: fee; bill; charge for a service or item
definitions.explanation: Suffix attached to nouns to indicate the cost, fee, or bill associated with that thing or service.

examples.japanese: {電気|でんき}{代|だい}が{高|たか}い。
{今月|こんげつ}の{暖房|だんぼう}{代|だい}を{払|はら}った。
examples.english: I paid this month's heating bill.

examples.japanese: {食事|しょくじ}{代|だい}はこちらで{持|も}たせていただきます。
examples.english: Please let us pay for the meal.

notes:
Suffix attached to a noun to form the word for the bill or fee for that thing. Distinct from 〜{料|りょう} (fee, charge) which is more formal and 〜{費|ひ} (expense) which typically refers to a category of expenses.

COMPOUNDS:
- {電気|でんき}{代|だい}: electricity bill
- ガス{代|だい}: gas bill
- {水道|すいどう}{代|だい}: water bill
- {飲|の}み{代|だい}: drinking tab; bar bill
- タクシー{代|だい}: taxi fare
- {部屋|へや}{代|だい}: room charge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- 〜{料|りょう}: fee; charge — more formal; used for fixed institutional fees ({授業|じゅぎょう}{料|りょう} tuition)
- 〜{費|ひ}: expense — refers to a category of spending ({生活|せいかつ}{費|ひ} living expenses)
- 〜{賃|ちん}: fare; rent — used for transport fares and rent ({家|や}{賃|ちん} rent)
